Layout slider objects

Source: R/zz-gen-layout.R
go_layout_slider.Rd

Properties of layout.slider.

Usage

go_layout_slider(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  active = NULL,
  activebgcolor = NULL,
  bgcolor = NULL,
  bordercolor = NULL,
  borderwidth = NULL,
  currentvalue = NULL,
  font = NULL,
  len = NULL,
  lenmode = NULL,
  minorticklen = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  pad = NULL,
  steps = NULL,
  templateitemname = NULL,
  tickcolor = NULL,
  ticklen = NULL,
  tickwidth = NULL,
  transition = NULL,
  visible = NULL,
  x = NULL,
  xanchor = NULL,
  y = NULL,
  yanchor = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_slider_currentvalue(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  font = NULL,
  offset = NULL,
  prefix = NULL,
  suffix = NULL,
  visible = NULL,
  xanchor = NULL,
  skip_invalid = FALSE
)

go_layout_slider_currentvalue_font(
  arg = NULL,
  ...,
  color = NULL,
  family = NULL,
  lineposition = NULL,

  size = NULL,

  textcase = NULL,

go_layout_slider_font(
  arg = NULL,

  color = NULL,

  lineposition = NULL,
  shadow = NULL,
  size = NULL,

Arguments

arg

Optional named list, or graph object of the same type, to initialise properties from (constructors). Named arguments take precedence.

...

Further properties, including nested properties in "magic underscore" form, e.g. marker_size = 10 for marker = list(size = 10). Property values may be one-sided formulas, evaluated in data for add_*() functions.

active

Determines which button (by index starting from 0) is considered active. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

activebgcolor

Sets the background color of the slider grip while dragging. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

bgcolor

Sets the background color of the slider. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

bordercolor

Sets the color of the border enclosing the slider. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

borderwidth

Sets the width (in px) of the border enclosing the slider. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

currentvalue

Named list or go_layout_slider_currentvalue() object.

font

go_layout_slider(): Sets the font of the slider step labels. Named list or go_layout_slider_font() object.

go_layout_slider_currentvalue(): Sets the font of the current value label text. Named list or go_layout_slider_currentvalue_font() object.

len

Sets the length of the slider This measure excludes the padding of both ends. That is, the slider's length is this length minus the padding on both ends. Number in the interval [0, Inf].

lenmode

Determines whether this slider length is set in units of plot "fraction" or in *pixels. Use `len` to set the value. One of "fraction", "pixels".

minorticklen

Sets the length in pixels of minor step tick marks Number in the interval [0, Inf].

name

When used in a template, named items are created in the output figure in addition to any items the figure already has in this array. You can modify these items in the output figure by making your own item with `templateitemname` matching this `name` alongside your modifications (including `visible: false` or `enabled: false` to hide it). Has no effect outside of a template. String.

pad

Set the padding of the slider component along each side. Named list or go_layout_slider_pad() object.

steps

List of named lists or go_layout_slider_step() objects.

templateitemname

Used to refer to a named item in this array in the template. Named items from the template will be created even without a matching item in the input figure, but you can modify one by making an item with `templateitemname` matching its `name`, alongside your modifications (including `visible: false` or `enabled: false` to hide it). If there is no template or no matching item, this item will be hidden unless you explicitly show it with `visible: true`. String.

tickcolor

Sets the color of the border enclosing the slider. Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

ticklen

Sets the length in pixels of step tick marks Number in the interval [0, Inf].

tickwidth

Sets the tick width (in px). Number in the interval [0, Inf].

transition

Named list or go_layout_slider_transition() object.

visible

go_layout_slider(): Determines whether or not the slider is visible. Logical.

go_layout_slider_currentvalue(): Shows the currently-selected value above the slider. Logical.

go_layout_slider_step(): Determines whether or not this step is included in the slider. Logical.

x

Sets the x position (in normalized coordinates) of the slider. Number in the interval [-2, 3].

xanchor

go_layout_slider(): Sets the slider's horizontal position anchor. This anchor binds the `x` position to the "left", "center" or "right" of the range selector. One of "auto", "left", "center", "right".

go_layout_slider_currentvalue(): The alignment of the value readout relative to the length of the slider. One of "left", "center", "right".

y

Sets the y position (in normalized coordinates) of the slider. Number in the interval [-2, 3].

yanchor

Sets the slider's vertical position anchor This anchor binds the `y` position to the "top", "middle" or "bottom" of the range selector. One of "auto", "top", "middle", "bottom".

skip_invalid

If TRUE, silently drop invalid properties instead of raising an error.

offset

The amount of space, in pixels, between the current value label and the slider. Number.

prefix

When currentvalue.visible is true, this sets the prefix of the label. String.

suffix

When currentvalue.visible is true, this sets the suffix of the label. String.

color

Color: a CSS color string or R color name.

family

HTML font family - the typeface that will be applied by the web browser. The web browser can only apply a font if it is available on the system where it runs. Provide multiple font families, separated by commas, to indicate the order in which to apply fonts if they aren't available. String.

lineposition

Sets the kind of decoration line(s) with text, such as an "under", "over" or "through" as well as combinations e.g. "under+over", etc. Any combination of "under", "over", "through" joined with "+", or one of "none".

shadow

Sets the shape and color of the shadow behind text. "auto" places minimal shadow and applies contrast text font color. See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/text-shadow for additional options. String.

size

Number in the interval [1, Inf].

style

Sets whether a font should be styled with a normal or italic face from its family. One of "normal", "italic".

textcase

Sets capitalization of text. It can be used to make text appear in all-uppercase or all-lowercase, or with each word capitalized. One of "normal", "word caps", "upper", "lower".

variant

Sets the variant of the font. One of "normal", "small-caps", "all-small-caps", "all-petite-caps", "petite-caps", "unicase".

weight

Sets the weight (or boldness) of the font. Integer in the interval [1, 1000].

b

The amount of padding (in px) along the bottom of the component. Number.

l

The amount of padding (in px) on the left side of the component. Number.

r

The amount of padding (in px) on the right side of the component. Number.

t

The amount of padding (in px) along the top of the component. Number.

args

Sets the arguments values to be passed to the Plotly method set in `method` on slide. Vector or list of up to 3 element(s).

execute

When true, the API method is executed. When false, all other behaviors are the same and command execution is skipped. This may be useful when hooking into, for example, the `plotly_sliderchange` method and executing the API command manually without losing the benefit of the slider automatically binding to the state of the plot through the specification of `method` and `args`. Logical.

label

Sets the text label to appear on the slider String.

method

Sets the Plotly method to be called when the slider value is changed. If the `skip` method is used, the API slider will function as normal but will perform no API calls and will not bind automatically to state updates. This may be used to create a component interface and attach to slider events manually via JavaScript. One of "restyle", "relayout", "animate", "update", "skip".

value

Sets the value of the slider step, used to refer to the step programatically. Defaults to the slider label if not provided. String.

duration

Sets the duration of the slider transition Number in the interval [0, Inf].

easing

Sets the easing function of the slider transition One of "linear", "quad", "cubic", "sin", "exp", "circle", "elastic", "back", "bounce", "linear-in", "quad-in", "cubic-in", "sin-in", "exp-in", "circle-in", "elastic-in", "back-in", "bounce-in", "linear-out", "quad-out", "cubic-out", "sin-out", "exp-out", "circle-out", "elastic-out", "back-out", "bounce-out", "linear-in-out", "quad-in-out", "cubic-in-out", "sin-in-out", "exp-in-out", "circle-in-out", "elastic-in-out", "back-in-out", "bounce-in-out".

Value

Each go_*() function returns a graph object of the same class as its name; add_*() functions return the modified figure.

Details

go_layout_slider() and the nested object constructors below create validated graph objects (named lists). Every property is checked against the plotly.js schema when an object is created or modified (see plotly_obj-modify()).

Nested objects documented here:

go_layout_slider_font()

layout.slider.font: Sets the font of the slider step labels.

go_layout_slider_pad()

layout.slider.pad: Set the padding of the slider component along each side.
